QuestionStmt.S: Propene on hydroboration followed by oxidation with alkaline peroxide forms.

Solution.S:
Hydroboration of propene followed by oxidation with alkaline hydrogen peroxide gives propan-1-ol (anti-Markovnikov addition). The reaction proceeds through tri-n-propylborane intermediate.

$$\mathrm{CH_3CH=CH_2 \xrightarrow{B_2H_6} (CH_3CH_2CH_2)_3B \xrightarrow{H_2O_2/OH^-} CH_3CH_2CH_2OH}$$

Thus the final product is propan-1-ol, which corresponds to option C.
